main_text.l: physicæ pars, quæ agit de Ente,
physica specialis, quæ descendit ad species
revera quoque consistunt, in iisque spectat
nus illud in rebus incorporeis & immate-
rialibus fieri potest. Atque ut appareat, quæ
species Entis huc referendæ sint, quæ non,
instituenda est Entis in suas species aut
nes Entis, ut thesi 8. c. 2. libri superioris
Accidens, vel in Deum & Creaturam di-
vidi potest. utraque ex æquo totam entis
latitudinem exhaurit. Nec facilè dixeris utram

page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut-style letter, joined to "Bsoluta" as "ABsoluta". The signature mark at the foot is hard to read and is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The "præsuppofuimus" form in the print has long s, so it is given as "præsupposuimus".
